skills.name: Flaming Blade (炎の刃)
skills.line: You have no meaning of living.
skills.description: SP Youtou Hime uses her long katana to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Relentless (穷追不舍/深追い)
skills.description:
At the end of SP Youtou Hime's turn, she Locks onto the non-summonable enemy with the lowest proportion of HP.
SP Youtou Hime increases her damage dealt by 1% and SPD by 1 for each 1% of HP that the non-summoned enemy with the lowest proportion of HP loses. ;Locked (ロック) :'''General, Mark''': At the start of her next turn, this effect is consumed to deal damage equal to 100% of her ATK to the Locked on enemy. The damage from this attack does not trigger souls or passives and cannot be shared. :''(Red flames will appear underneath the marked enemy.)''

upgrades.text: When dealing damage to a Locked on enemy, has a 100% base chance to inflict them Isolation.

skills.name: Crimson Slash (赤影一瞬)
skills.line: The anger and judgement of the Minamoto clan.
skills.description: SP Youtou Hime draws her blade from the rift where the space is torn open and channels all of her power to slash 1 enemy, dealing damage equal to 295% of her ATK. ;Crimson Breath (赤影の息) : :'''Buff, Status''': Increases her damage dealt by 15% per layer (max of 90%).

upgrades.text: When this attack KO's a non-summoned enemy, she gains Crimson Breath.
When this attack KO's a non-summoned enemy, she gains a new turn that does not trigger Locked.
When this attack KO's an enemy, using Crimson Slash in the new turn will not consume any onibi .
In the new turn, Crimson Slash deals an additional 30% of damage that cannot be shared and doesn't trigger the target's souls or passive.

bio.condition: With SP Youtou Hime clear any zone 30 times.
Increase SP Youtou Hime's level to 40.
Increase SP Youtou Hime's skill 6 times.
